packageRules.description: The crossplane chart in cicd/crossplane.yaml.gotmpl is not bumped here. Its one pin source is the KCL catalog (stuttgart-things/kcl, crossplane/xplane-crossplane-catalog, crossplaneVersion), which also generates the Flux machinery profile; a Renovate bump in this repo alone puts kind clusters on a different Crossplane than Flux-built ones. Bump it by hand to what the catalog pins, as the providers, functions and configurations in cicd/crossplane-*.yaml.gotmpl already are (they carry no renovate annotation on purpose). Remove this rule once the kind play installs the Flux profile instead (stuttgart-things/stuttgart-things#3136). stuttgart-things/flux#521

customManagers.description: Chart versions parameterized through helmfile environment values (invisible to the helmfile manager)
Same, but where the environment value itself carries a Go template default
